================ PawnIO.Modules 原始组件声明 ================

# Third-party notices

RevoHelper's own code is licensed under MIT. Third-party components retain
their own licenses; the MIT license does not relicense the modules below.

## PawnIO.Modules 0.2.2 embedded by LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6

The unmodified LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6 NuGet library embeds these twelve
signed PawnIO modules: `AMDFamily0F`, `AMDFamily10`, `AMDFamily17`, `IntelMSR`,
`IsaBridgeEC`, `LpcACPIEC`, `LpcCrOSEC`, `LpcIO`, `RyzenSMU`, `SmbusI801`,
`SmbusNCT6793`, and `SmbusPIIX4`.

- Project: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules
- Release: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.2
- Corresponding source: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/tree/0.2.2
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later
- Copyright: namazso and respective upstream contributors
- Local original source archive: `packaging/ThirdPartySource/PawnIO.Modules-0.2.2-source.zip`
- LHM update record: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/commit/4b3ed8bb4623128927480aaa8cdf0d9e09ebc999

All twelve embedded module files were compared byte-for-byte with the official
0.2.2 release archive and match. The old resource README in LHM still refers
to 0.1.6; the update record and actual embedded bytes establish 0.2.2 here.
The complete upstream LHM third-party notice is retained at
`packaging/ThirdParty/LibreHardwareMonitor-0.9.6-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.
The 0.2.2 archive is also included as a separately identified Base64 source
attachment in the generated `Third-Party.txt`.

## PawnIO.Modules IntelMSR 0.2.10

RevoHelper embeds the official signed `IntelMSR.bin` module from PawnIO.Modules
release 0.2.10. The module provides the narrowly scoped `ioctl_read_msr` and
`ioctl_write_msr` entry points used by the Intel RAPL backend; RevoHelper does
not install or replace the PawnIO driver.

- Project: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules
- Release: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.10
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later
- Embedded file SHA-256: `D6ED85D65AB17A22F813EF98207D6D537155EE2DED5976A21CB48413C9B92E5F`

The corresponding source is available in the upstream project. PawnIO itself
is a separate dependency and remains subject to its own license and terms.
The original 0.2.10 source archive is retained at
`packaging/ThirdPartySource/PawnIO.Modules-0.2.10-source.zip` and as a separate
Base64 attachment in the generated `Third-Party.txt`.

## PawnIO.Modules IntelMCHBAR 0.2.10

RevoHelper embeds the official signed `IntelMCHBAR.bin` module from
PawnIO.Modules release 0.2.10 for read-only diagnosis. RevoHelper calls only
`ioctl_get_mchbar_addr` and `ioctl_read_qword`; this module exposes no MCHBAR
write entry point.

- Project: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules
- Release: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.10
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later
- Embedded file SHA-256: `3F82B832D99B4AAC37D2A20FDB7C9BAA2A3BC0488612C9019C9484EB0E8A6EAE`

The corresponding source is available in the upstream project.


================ LibreHardwareMonitor 原始组件声明 ================

# Third-Party Notices

## LibreHardwareMonitorLib

RevoHelper uses `LibreHardwareMonitorLib` for read-only CPU and GPU sensor discovery.

- Upstream: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor
- Package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/LibreHardwareMonitorLib/0.9.6
- Exact package source: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/tree/3d331e3370efb858411f19511373eff65a218701
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

RevoHelper consumes the unmodified NuGet library as a separate dependency.
Its MPL-covered source remains available under MPL 2.0 at the exact source
link above; RevoHelper's MIT license does not replace that license.

The upstream original third-party notice is preserved verbatim at
`packaging/ThirdParty/LibreHardwareMonitor-0.9.6-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` and is
included in the generated `Third-Party.txt`. It contains the Aga.Controls BSD
notice and PawnIO.Modules LGPL 2.1 notice. Retaining the complete upstream
notice does not mean RevoHelper includes LHM's desktop GUI or Aga.Controls.

The library embeds twelve PawnIO.Modules 0.2.2 binaries. Their provenance and
corresponding source archive are documented in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at the
repository root; both 0.2.2 and the separately used 0.2.10 source archives are
supplied in the release's combined third-party notice.

## PresentMon 2.6.0

RevoHelper embeds the unmodified standalone x64 console collector, not the
PresentMon GUI, installer, service, or driver.

- Release: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/tag/v2.6.0
- Source: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/tree/v2.6.0
- License: MIT; original text at `packaging/PresentMon/LICENSE.txt`
- Provenance: `packaging/PresentMon/README.md`

The original MIT notice is included in `Third-Party.txt` by default.

* mono/utils/bsearch.c: BSD license.

完整的来源记录与 MIT 许可原文如下。

License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/v2.6.0/LICENSE.txt

The original executable is embedded in RevoHelper. Enabling the performance monitor extracts the collector into the current user's versioned local cache and starts an owned hidden child process. This does not install a service, driver, or inject code into the measured application. Turning off the monitor stops its collector. The standalone upstream executable is otherwise unmodified. Retain LICENSE.txt in the source package and include it in Third-Party.txt when distributing RevoHelper.

================ 第三方对应源码附件 ================

附件一：PawnIO.Modules-0.2.2-source.zip（LibreHardwareMonitorLib 内嵌模块）
来源：https://codeload.github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/zip/refs/tags/0.2.2
附件二：PawnIO.Modules-0.2.10-source.zip（RevoHelper 另行内嵌的两个模块）
来源：https://codeload.github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/zip/refs/tags/0.2.10
编码：标准 Base64，解码后即为各自的原始 ZIP；没有修改或执行其中的源码。

需要源码时，可直接使用上方的公开源代码地址，也可以提取这两个附件。
本地提取方法：在 Third-Party.txt 所在目录打开 PowerShell，运行以下命令。
命令只创建两个源码 ZIP；若任一同名文件已存在，则停止，不会覆盖。

$notice = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.\Third-Party.txt' -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$attachments = [regex]::Matches($notice, '(?m)^BEGIN_PAWNIO_SOURCE_BASE64_(?<version>0_2_2|0_2_10)\r?\n(?<payload>[A-Za-z0-9+/=\r\n]+)^END_PAWNIO_SOURCE_BASE64_\k<version>\r?$', [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline)
if ($attachments.Count -ne 2) { throw '找不到两个完整的源码附件' }
$sources = @($attachments | ForEach-Object {
    $version = $_.Groups['version'].Value.Replace('_', '.')
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Path = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path "PawnIO.Modules-$version-source.zip"
        Bytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($_.Groups['payload'].Value)
    }
})
foreach ($source in $sources) {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source.Path) { throw "文件已存在，不会覆盖：$($source.Path)" }
}
foreach ($source in $sources) {
    $sourceFile = [IO.File]::Open($source.Path, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew)
    try { $sourceFile.Write($source.Bytes, 0, $source.Bytes.Length) } finally { $sourceFile.Dispose() }
}
